summary: Frontend-only smoke test for Brazil Lacrosse demo readiness. Verified: login works in real browser (no splash trap), staff dashboard renders full rich demo dataset (16 athletes, populated KPIs, multiple charts, radar, pain-by-body-region with 5 regions, menstrual monitor with 3 in-period athletes incl. Severe + Very-Severe alerts, active alerts), and athlete detail page (Lucas Silva) shows ACWR card (1.00 SWEET SPOT), weekly load trend, compliance (100%/47.8%), readiness vs team comparison chart, pain location map (2 marker areas - Elbow 8/10 + WristHand 7/10), and tabs (Readiness/Workload/CMJ/Pain Report/Compliance/History). 0 JS console errors on dashboard and athlete detail.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate the 2 generic 404s on dashboard load (probably /manifest icon or stale sw asset). Does not affect functionality.

(Optional, demo polish) The individual radar's 'No check-in for today' empty state on Lucas Silva is correct data-wise but breaks the visual flow at the bottom of his page. Consider auto-falling-back to most-recent-day-with-data or pre-selecting Yesterday so the radar is always populated on first view.
critical_code_review_comments: AthleteDetail.js: Individual readiness radar's 'No check-in' empty state could auto-fallback to the most recent checked-in day when Today has no data. UX nit.
Service worker registration appears to be working (no splash trap reproduced in headless Chromium after one SW unregister+reload). HTML/JS network-first fix verified.
CMJ tab content was not deep-validated (tab presence confirmed, click-into-tab content not asserted) — recommend a follow-up test if CMJ rendering for demo is critical.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (all primary demo views render with rich data; one minor empty-state UX nit + 2 inconsequential 404s)

seed_data_creation: No new seed run; previously seeded data via /api/seed-demo is fully reflected (16 athletes, ~45 days, period+pain reports, CMJ baselines per agent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Splash-screen + login is unblocked in a real Chromium browser. Useful selectors: input[type='email']/[type='password'], button[type='submit'] for login. Athlete sidebar uses data-testid='athlete-link-<UUID>'. Direct nav works: /staff/athlete/<uuid>. AthleteDetail uses tab labels Readiness/Workload/CMJ/Pain Report/Compliance/History — currently script only validated default Readiness tab; CMJ tab content was not deep-clicked. Female monitor reads 3 in period / 8 total / 37.5% on date 2026-06-04 (today in app context). The 2 generic '404' console errors on dashboard load are unidentified static-asset 404s — non-blocking but worth investigating in a future iteration. The previously-suspected 'email input losing value in iframe' issue (mentioned in main-agent context) is NOT reproduced in direct browser context — login works end-to-end.
rca of the issue: No critical bug found. The only soft issue (individual radar 'No check-in data for Today') is a legitimate data state — Lucas Silva is one of the 2 athletes with missing check-ins today; selecting Yesterday or earlier in the radar's day-picker would populate it. Recommend auto-falling-back to the most recent day with data on initial render.
